notes.title: v1.1.39
notes.content:
Now that SlayinDX is out, I can resume bug fixing Slayin 2. Sorry this update took so long.

- Leaderboard list sorted by Player was not displaying the proper entires.
- Player 2 Actions were activating from Player 2 Jump inputs.
- Princess horn weapon was rotated incorrectly when neutral jumping.
